scientific_question: After the seven-trunk representation misses the strict 5TPP gate, do its two remaining shared groups still exhibit destructive same-checkpoint task-gradient cancellation, or has tangent alignment passed while endpoint/function matching remains insufficient?

measurement.method: freeze all parameters, locally untie each layer c_fc/c_proj from its shared trunk, and measure exact same-checkpoint task gradients

interpretation_rule.persistent_conflict: if the current partition minimum is below 0.8 or mean is below 0.9, reject cross-layer dense-trunk sharing as geometrically nonstationary over training
interpretation_rule.endpoint_mismatch: if both recovery thresholds pass while validation remains +0.0698 behind attention-only, conclude that tangent alignment is insufficient and the remaining defect is endpoint/functional mismatch rather than common-update cancellation
interpretation_rule.forbidden_inference: the audit cannot authorize an eighth trunk, layer-private dense MLPs, model-size scaling, or a new training run
